cohort_total_n_excerpt: Fifty-six patients with newly diagnosed prostate cancer and 56 hospital controls were enrolled in this study.
reason: The study evaluates newly diagnosed prostate cancer overall. The abstract does not report an aggressive, advanced, high-grade, metastatic, or lethal incident prostate cancer analysis.

estimate_classifications.endpoint_excerpt: The adjusted ORs for prostate cancer in comparison with the highest to lowest categories were 0.06 (95 % CI 0.02-0.24) for serum genistein, 0.18 (95 % CI 0.06-0.52) for daidzein, 0.16 (95 % CI 0.06-0.46) for glycitein, 0.52 (95 % CI 0.22-1.22) for equol, 0.86 (95 % CI 0.30-2.48) for dietary genistein, and 0.80 (95 % CI 0.28-2.28) for dietary daidzein.
estimate_classifications.reason: The row is the reported dietary genistein association with overall newly diagnosed prostate cancer, not an aggressive subtype.
